entries.title: Your lessons have a progress panel
entries.body: After your first finished lesson in a subject, a progress panel appears at the side with your goal, the days you practised and the skills you learned. Every five days of practice earns a rest day, up to two, and a holiday you ask for keeps your run going; the panel's next-lesson button opens your waiting lesson card.

picture.alt: The Chess panel shows the learner's goal, three days practised, skill progress and a next-lesson button beside the lesson card.
